purpose: Make RedCap validation strength explicit and risk-based, so small tasks do not automatically pay release-grade validation cost while safety-critical tasks remain fail-closed.

tiers.label: 轻量任务
tiers.when_to_use: Report, catalog, human-facing text, low-risk route notes, or bookkeeping changes that do not alter runtime, package surface, release policy, security, provider routing, destructive migration, or closeout behavior.

tiers.label: 标准实现任务
tiers.when_to_use: Normal code or policy work that changes RedCap behavior but does not touch publication, package contents, private data, destructive migration, root information architecture, or release-readiness boundaries.
conditional_checks: full-acceptance when shared acceptance framework changes
package-safety when package candidate surface changes

tiers.label: 发布/结构迁移任务
tiers.when_to_use: Release readiness, package surface, runtime packaging, secret-safety, destructive migration, root information architecture, old-anchor retirement, clean workspace install behavior, closeout runtime, or validator chain changes.

hard_gate_overrides.reason: Publication and package surface changes affect external users and private-data exposure.
Validator and closeout changes can make RedCap claim false completion.
Physical migration and root information architecture changes can break archaeology, receipts, aliases, and rollback.
Secret, identity, and notification changes are safety-sensitive even if the patch looks small.

post_result_drift_allowlist.meaning: Paths that may change after a clean workspace E2E result without invalidating install/package evidence. These are report, catalog, or evidence-index surfaces that are not package candidates and do not alter runtime behavior.

must_not_claim: Gate stratification does not permit skipping release, package-safety, secret-safety, destructive-migration, old-anchor-retirement, root-information-architecture, Prism-required, or closeout gates.
A lightweight task is not automatically safe; touched paths and hard_gate_overrides can force release-structural validation.
Clean workspace E2E freshness can ignore only explicitly allowlisted report/index drift, never runtime, package, validator, secret, or destructive-migration drift.
